items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Were there other bands you played in beside Pete Lala's and the Frank Doosan?

ctx.x: Were there other bands you played in beside Pete Lala's and the Frank Doosan? Do you remember some of the other bands?
No, I went, I taught, I taught bands in 1932, 1937.
